evals.prompt: The party attended a harvest festival in Ardenville on 0496-03-15 where they entered a pie-eating contest and Claire won. They also met a traveling bard who told them about ruins to the south. Create an event for this.
evals.expected_output: A paired private/public event file with date-prefixed filename, correct paths matching existing vault events, embed in private file, proper YAML frontmatter, and correct dataview queries.

assertions.text: Private file placed in Private/2. Reference/Events/World Events/Timeline/ (matching existing vault events, NOT in Private/2. Session Journals/ or Private/1. World Almanac/)
Public file placed in Public/World/Events/Timeline/
Both filenames prefixed with fc-date: 0496-03-15 {Event Name}.md
Private YAML has all required fields: type, name, fc-date, fc-category, location, region, tags
Public YAML has required fields: type, name, fc-date, location, region, tags
Private file embeds public file with ![[Public/World/Events/Timeline/...]]
Private dataview uses FROM [[]] (not FROM [[#this.file.name]])
Public dataview uses FROM [[]] AND "Public"
Public note uses only public wiki-links (Public/World/...)
Public What Happened section has 3-5 bullet points
Brevity: both files scannable in 10 seconds — fragments and bullets, not prose
Private file has Consequences section (even if brief)
tags include Event, Crestfall
No unrequested optional sections (Secrets, Follow-Up Hooks) unless user asked

evals.prompt: Create an event for the Great Blight of Hillcrest — a historical event where a mysterious fungal plague nearly destroyed Hillcrest's crops generations ago. No specific date known.
evals.expected_output: Agent should find the existing 'The Great Blight of Hillcrest.md' file and present it rather than creating a duplicate.

assertions.text: Agent searched the vault and found existing 'The Great Blight of Hillcrest' file
Agent did NOT create a duplicate event file
Agent presented the existing file content or referenced it
Agent offered to update/expand the existing file rather than creating new

evals.prompt: Create an event for when the mine collapsed in Highreach after the party killed the boss monster.
evals.expected_output: Agent should find the existing '0496-03-06 Highreach Mine Collapses' event files (both private and public) and present them rather than creating duplicates.

assertions.text: Agent searched the vault and found existing Highreach Mine Collapses event
Agent did NOT create duplicate event files
Agent presented the existing file content or referenced it
Agent offered to update/expand the existing files rather than creating new
